central_question: When a foundation species remains present despite quantitative change, what carries persistence forward: stored internal state, self-engineered physical state, community substitution, or persistent site template?

internal_state.minimum_supported_statement: hidden below-ground state adds prospective information beyond current visible state and stable node identity

required_links: direct paired physical contrast demonstrates canopy-associated modification
measured engineered state predicts future focal quantitative state after ambient exposure and baseline state

community_continuity.rule: alternative-species occurrence alone supports occupancy continuity, not functional insurance

persistent_site_template.rule: cross-node association alone cannot distinguish a carrier from stable site quality

internal_path: reserve state -> future local Thalassia state

paper_level_gate.multicarrier_claim_requires: direct prospective support for at least two carrier classes
paper_level_gate.all_unsupported: retain state-decoupling result and reject measured carrier candidates without reopening retrospective mechanism mining

prohibited: call alternative-species occupancy functional insurance without measured function
claim self-engineering without paired physical attribution
claim ecological memory from cross-node association alone
retune thresholds or endpoints after future outcome access
